message.reasoning:
The user wants to arrange a flight for booking number 1234 as soon as possible, and wants to check different options. They want to calculate the cost from the first airport in the available list to the last airport in the same list, on the last day of October 2024, business class. Provide estimated total payable amount.

We need to get the list of all airports. Then get the first and last airport codes. Then get flight cost for travel_from=first, travel_to=last, travel_date=2024-10-31, travel_class=business. That returns cost in USD. Then we need to provide estimated total payable amount. But we also need to consider that the user wants to arrange a flight for booking number 1234. We might need to book the flight? The user says "I need to arrange a flight for booking number 1234 as soon as possible". That implies we need to book a flight for that booking number. But we don't have an access token. We need to authenticate first. But we don't have client_id, client_secret, etc. The user didn't provide them. We cannot proceed. We can ask for credentials. But maybe we can just compute the cost. The user wants the estimated total payable amount. That might be just the flight cost. But maybe we need to include insurance? No mention. So just flight cost.

We need to call get_all_airports. Then get_flight_cost. Then provide the cost. We don't need to book. So we can do that.
